subject: Enabling three additional squads at Integris — rollout, pricing, and PO timing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@integrishealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Enabling three additional squads at Integris — rollout, pricing, and PO timing

Hi Alex —

Great catching up last week. Per our call, Integris is ready to expand the deployment to three additional squads (two clinical-facing apps + one analytics pipeline). I put together a short proposed rollout and preliminary commercial approach: attached integration-plan-v1.pdf and a draft amendment (amendment-draft.docx).

High level:
- 3 new API keys scoped to each squad (isolation + audit logging)
- Temporary burst capacity for the first 30 days while teams ramp
- Suggested term amendment: add 150M tokens/month committed across the new teams for a 12‑month addendum at a 8% unit discount vs current list
- Rollout timeline: provision keys week 1, sandbox tests week 2, canary in production week 3, full ramp end of week 6

Asks:
1) Can you confirm preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly invoicing)?
2) Would procurement need an updated SOW or are you comfortable with an amendment + PO?
3) Who should we loop in from engineering for the kickoff (name + best times next week)?

If it helps, I can share the amended pricing spreadsheet and a short one-page kickoff agenda. Would you be available for a 30-min sync this Wednesday or Thursday?

Thanks — looking forward to getting these squads live.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: integration-plan-v1.pdf (pdf), amendment-draft.docx (docx)
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@integrishealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lily Tran <lily.tran@integrishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Mar 2028 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Enabling three additional squads at Integris — rollout, pricing, and PO timing

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the materials. Quick answers up front: procurement prefers a single PO for the amendment (quarterly invoicing is fine), but they need a line-itemized cost per squad to include in the PO. Engineering would like to see the expected latency/cost profile per squad (we have one high-throughput analytics job) and a short note on KV-cache isolation for clinical apps.

Can you provide:
- Per-squad monthly expected token estimate + incremental cost
- A short note on how keys are scoped (audit trail + key rotation)
- Whether we can pin model versions for the clinical squads for the first 90 days

Lily (cc) is procurement — she’ll want an amended commercial attachment. If we can land the pricing by Friday, I can present to procurement next Monday.

I’m available Thu 10–11am PT for a 30-min run-through.

— Alex
Alex Gomez
Director of Engineering, Integris Health
alex.gomez@integrishealth.com

Date: Wed, 8 Mar 2028 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Enabling three additional squads at Integris — ask: costing + kv isolation note

Marissa / team —

Attached is a quick capacity worksheet (capacity-worksheet.csv) with three scenarios: conservative, expected ramp, and aggressive ramp. Key points:
- Clinical squads: recommend pinning to v1.3.2 for 90 days to avoid model drift; allocate 20–30k tokens/day per squad initially (changeable).
- Analytics pipeline: expect spikes up to 5–6x baseline for nightly batch windows. Recommend a temporary burst allowance (auto-burst up to 200% of committed capacity for first 30 days) with a measured metered overage rate (we can apply discount tiers).
- Keys: we can scope keys to project-level with separate log streams; rotation can be automated every 30 days and we’ll provide a key rotation playbook for their security team.

Ben — suggested temporary rate: 0.6x of list for burst consumption during the 30-day ramp (to avoid sticker shock while they test).

I’ll convert the CSV to a per-squad line-item pricing sheet and send back by Thu EOD.

— Aditya

Attachments: capacity-worksheet.csv

Marissa / team —

Thanks — the notes and worksheet look good. Integris approves the approach in principle. Next steps we need to align on:
- Final per-squad line-item pricing from Redwood (requested by EOD Thu your side)
- A short one-page security note on key scoping/rotation for our InfoSec (Naomi — see cc)
- Proposed kickoff: Mar 15, 10am PT for a 60-min technical onboarding + procurement touchpoint

Procurement (Lily) will prepare the PO once they have the final amendment and the line-item pricing. We’re comfortable pinning clinical squads to the model version for the first 90 days. Please include a short clause about rollback/fallback in case of performance/regulatory issues.

I’ll circulate an internal approval once procurement confirms the PO window. For scheduling: Mar 15 10am PT works for me.
